code: unsigned int klass = buffer->idx < buffer->len ? machine.get_class (info[buffer->idx].codepoint, num_glyphs) : (unsigned) StateTable<EntryData>::CLASS_END_OF_TEXT;
note: When the state machine reaches end-of-text (buffer->idx == buffer->len) the driver does not stop: it selects CLASS_END_OF_TEXT and still dispatches the entry for that class, so the current-insert action runs with the index pointing past the last initialized glyph.

The current-insert path (entry->data.currentInsertIndex != 0xFFFF) with CurrentInsertBefore clear calls copy_glyph() without verifying that buffer->idx < buffer->len, so at end-of-text it copies a glyph from beyond the initialized buffer region.
copy_glyph() performs no bounds check against len and reads info[idx] with idx == len, copying uninitialized glyph info (including the codepoint) into the output buffer.
After the insertion subtable, swap_buffers() makes the output buffer (which contains the glyph copied from the uninitialized info[len]) the buffer consumed by the next morx subtable.
The next subtable's state machine reads info[idx].codepoint of the copied glyph and passes the uninitialized codepoint as the glyph id into the class table lookup.
The uninitialized codepoint is used as a glyph id in the lookup; the comparison is a branch on uninitialized data, producing the use-of-uninitialized-value.
